No. PMEGP/Policy/09/2021 dated 13.05.2022, signed by Anil Kumar, Under Secretary to the Government of India. Approves PMEGP continuation for 2021-22 to 2025-26 with Rs. 13,554.42 Crore outlay and ~4 lakh project / ~30 lakh employment targets. 28 pages including the O.M.
